goal: Keep a branch workstation connected to an application at another site during either supplied carrier outage.
context: Builds on tracing a campus path. This exercise supplies the possible circuit endpoints and the links that share each outage.

concepts.title: Connect separate sites
concepts.text: A wide area network (WAN) connects separate sites. Each site edge connects its local network to a carrier. A circuit is a connection offered between endpoints.

concepts.title: Look for a shared failure
concepts.text: Two circuits can use the same carrier. Both can work normally but fail together if the shared carrier is unavailable. Read which circuit options the supplied outage removes.

concepts.title: Verify service and separation
concepts.text: Compare both carrier outages and check a reply path as well. Connecting an unrelated visitor link can also open an unintended path. Keep all required separation while staying within the connection budget.

worked.label: Trace normal operation
worked.value: Workshop desk to Ferry to stock application
worked.explanation: Both selected workshop circuits use Ferry. The path reaches the application while Ferry is available.

worked.label: Trace after Ferry fails
worked.explanation: There is no path. A second connection through the same failed carrier cannot carry the exchange.

worked.label: Check independent circuits
worked.value:
Ferry outage: use Hill
Hill outage: use Ferry
worked.explanation: Choose one supplied circuit over each carrier. Confirm the visitor remains separate.

practice.title: Compare ordinary operation with a shared outage
practice.action: Select the training desk trial and Trace path. Select the Ferry outage trial and trace again.
practice.observe: The condition lists every circuit affected. Both training circuits are unavailable in that outage.

practice.title: Adjust optional connections
practice.action: Clear either Ferry option and attach a Hill option. Keep two optional connections.
practice.observe: Two distinct carrier paths can now reach the training application under either supplied outage.

practice.title: Verify the full work order
practice.action: Trace each carrier outage and the visitor trial before selecting Check workspace.
practice.observe: The surviving circuit changes with the outage. The visitor still has no application path.

requirements: Use at most two optional connections while keeping all fixed links attached.
Give the branch desk a path to the dispatch application in ordinary operation and during either supplied carrier outage. Preserve a reply path during the Ferry outage.
Keep the visitor device separate from the dispatch application.

review.introduction: Uses aligned examples to connect a traced path with site role and the stated outage.
review.example: A distinct training work order guides tracing and real circuit edits.
review.assignment: Grades normal and outage paths, the budget and the separate visitor.

goal: Keep printing within a small office and verify a hosted order desk through either supplied carrier outage.
context: Builds on tracing independent circuits. The printer and the hosted service are different destinations in the supplied layout.

concepts.title: Keep local work local
concepts.text: A small office/home office (SOHO) may keep its printer on the local network. A print job in this exercise travels from the studio laptop to the office gateway and then the printer.

concepts.title: Reach a different site
concepts.text: A hosted service is supplied at another site. Its path needs an office uplink, carrier and hosted edge. An uplink outage can prevent access to the hosted service while local printing continues.

concepts.title: Verify both paths and preserve separation
concepts.text: Check printing with an office uplink down. Compare each carrier outage for the hosted service. Keep the visitor off the paths to both destinations.

worked.label: Print a workshop agenda
worked.value: Laptop to office gateway to printer
worked.explanation: The printer’s local path does not use an office uplink.

worked.label: Open a hosted agenda
worked.value: Laptop to office gateway to fixed carrier to hosted edge
worked.explanation: The hosted service uses an office uplink and a remote site.

worked.label: Trace with the fixed carrier unavailable
worked.value:
Hosted: use backup carrier
Local: still use the office gateway
worked.explanation: The hosted trace must use an available second carrier. Printing remains local.

practice.title: Trace the local and hosted paths
practice.action: Trace the workshop printer in ordinary operation and without the office uplink. Then trace the hosted agenda without the fixed carrier.
practice.observe: The printer uses its original connection. The hosted trace fails while its only carrier is unavailable.

practice.title: Connect an independent option
practice.action: Keep the local printer and fixed carrier connected. Add the backup carrier connection.
practice.observe: The hosted path can now use either available carrier. The printer path is unchanged.

practice.title: Confirm the controls
practice.action: Trace the hosted service under both carrier conditions. Check both visitor trials and select Check workspace.
practice.observe: The visitor remains unable to reach the printer or hosted service.

requirements: Use at most three optional connections and keep the printer reachable in ordinary operation and without the fixed office uplink.
Give the laptop a path to the hosted order desk in ordinary operation and during both supplied carrier outages.
Keep the visitor kiosk separate from the printer and the hosted order desk.

review.introduction: Uses aligned examples to connect a traced path with site role and the stated outage.
review.example: A distinct training work order guides tracing and real circuit edits.
review.assignment: Grades normal and outage paths, the budget and the separate visitor.
